# Nalanda College Science Society (NCSS)

This the official website of the Nalanda College Science Society.
It provides news, updates, magazines, and competition registrations for students.

## Key Information
- Organization: Nalanda College Science Society
- Website: https://ncsciencesociety.com
- Email: info@ncsciencesociety.com

## Main Sections
- [Home](https://ncsciencesociety.com/)
- [News & Updates](https://ncsciencesociety.com/news)
- [Competitions](https://ncsciencesociety.com/competitions)
- [Magazine](https://ncsciencesociety.com/magazines)
- [About Us](https://ncsciencesociety.com/about)
- [Contact](https://ncsciencesociety.com/contact)
